concepts.title: The Polymathic Operating System
concepts.excerpt: The uncomfortable entry point: none of the ten dimensions alone distinguishes extraordinary creators from merely competent ones.

concepts.title: Infinite Devotion
concepts.excerpt: The three levels aren't a hierarchy to ascend — they're structurally different relationships to work:

concepts.title: Polymathic Breadth
concepts.excerpt: This is the structural argument against the conventional wisdom that forces a choice between depth and breadth.

concepts.title: Mental Models Library
concepts.excerpt: The distinction that matters: mental models are not heuristics. A heuristic is a rule of thumb — "birds of a feather flock together," "diversify your investments."

concepts.title: Integrative Complexity
concepts.excerpt: Differentiation is the capacity to see multiple distinct sides of an issue as genuinely different — not as variations of the same position, not as different phrasings of the same idea, but as legitimately separate positions with their own logic, evidence, and implications.

concepts.title: Long Game Orientation
concepts.excerpt: This is not patience as a virtue. It's patience as a structural exploit.

concepts.title: Deliberate Experimentation
concepts.excerpt: This is how extraordinary performers treat their own work as a domain of investigation rather than a domain of execution.

concepts.title: Strategic Thinking (Dimension 7)
concepts.excerpt: A chess player who picks up a piece before seeing the whole board is going to make moves that are locally sensible and strategically damaging.

concepts.title: Narrative Intelligence
concepts.excerpt: This is the layer the Narrative Architecture Hub covers in depth.

concepts.title: Archetypal Thinking
concepts.excerpt: This is not astrology, Jungian therapy, or literary criticism — though it draws on all three.

concepts.title: Astrological Thinking (Vedic)
concepts.excerpt: Vedic astrology — Jyotish — was not designed as a self-development tool.

concepts.title: Hyoho — Strategy as the Way
concepts.excerpt: There is a word in Japanese — hyoho — that English renders as "strategy," and in doing so loses most of what it means.

concepts.title: History as Strategic Resource
concepts.excerpt: History functions as a strategic resource in two distinct modes: as master (teacher of principles; source of rules to conform to) and as servant (rhetorical tool; instrument for building legitimacy, reducing resistance, and shaping perceived inevitability).

concepts.title: Curriculum for Homo Amicus: Fifteen-Domain Reconstruction Architecture
concepts.excerpt: Sam Keen identifies that reconstructing homo amicus (the friendly human) cannot be left to individual therapy or moral exhortation.
